releases.notes:
- Fixed waypoint icons not displaying on the locator bar.
- Fixed 'blinking' waypoints due to waypoints being cleared instead of updated.
- Fixed bug with player waypoints showing the local player's skin instead of the target player.
- Fixed locator waypoints showing up in creative and spectator mode.
